title: PPDS Plugin Registration Configuration
description: Schema for plugin registration configuration files used by the PPDS CLI.

version.description: Enforced contract: missing/1.0 legacy optional preservation; 2.0 explicitly opts into full supported nonsecret desired fields. Unknown versions are rejected before connection.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the configuration was generated (Zulu time format).

assemblies.description: List of plugin assemblies in this configuration.

customApis.description: Existing Custom API authoring input; excluded from nonsecret step/image equality verification.

assembly.description: Configuration for a single plugin assembly.

type.description: Assembly type: 'Assembly' for classic DLL, 'Nuget' for NuGet package.

path.description: Relative path to the assembly DLL (from the config file location). Use forward slashes for cross-platform compatibility.

packagePath.description: Relative path to the NuGet package (for Nuget type only).

packageContentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the NuGet package snapshot used to extract this configuration.

solution.description: Solution unique name to add components to.

allTypeNames.description: Concrete runtime IPlugin implementations and PPDS-annotated plugin type names in this assembly (for orphan detection), including runtime types with no configured steps.

types.description: Plugin types with their step registrations.

customApis.description: Existing Custom API authoring input; excluded from nonsecret step/image equality verification.

pluginType.description: Configuration for a single plugin type (class).

steps.description: Step registrations for this plugin type.

step.description: Configuration for a single plugin step registration.

name.description: Display name for the step. Auto-generated if not specified: '{TypeName}: {Message} of {Entity}'.

message.description: SDK message name (Create, Update, Delete, Retrieve, etc.).

entity.description: Primary entity logical name. Use 'none' for global messages.

secondaryEntity.description: Secondary entity logical name for relationship messages (Associate, etc.).

stage.description: Pipeline stage. MainOperation is for Custom API plugins.

executionOrder.description: Execution order when multiple plugins handle the same event.

filteringAttributes.description: Version 1: omitted/null/empty preserves. Version 2: omitted/null/empty clears; nonempty ordinary text is supplied state. Partial Update empty-string clears remain distinct from register placeholders.

unsecureConfiguration.description: Version 1: omitted/null/empty preserves. Version 2: omitted/null/empty clears; nonempty ordinary text is supplied state. Partial Update empty-string clears remain distinct from register placeholders.

deployment.description: Always managed in file deployment: omitted/null defaults ServerOnly for both versions.

runAsUser.description: Version 1 omission/null/empty preserves; explicit CallingUser clears. Version 2 omitted/null/empty defaults CallingUser. GUID/domain/email selects one valid user. System is not a registration selector.

description.description: Version 1: omitted/null/empty preserves. Version 2: omitted/null/empty clears; nonempty ordinary text is supplied state. Partial Update empty-string clears remain distinct from register placeholders.

asyncAutoDelete.description: Version 1 omission/null preserves, supplied false/true writes for async. Version 2 omitted/null defaults false for async. True is invalid for synchronous mode.

stepId.description: Step identifier for associating images with specific steps on multi-step plugins.

images.description: Configured image registrations. Omission/empty never authorizes independent image deletion. Extra images remain drift; pruning requires a separately adopted ownership contract.

canBeBypassed.description: Version 1 omission/null preserves. Version 2 omission/null uses explicit PPDS default true; supplied booleans write.

canUseReadOnlyConnection.description: Version 1 omission/null preserves. Version 2 omission/null uses explicit PPDS default false; supplied booleans write.

secureConfiguration.description: Write-only input in both versions: null/omission preserves, non-null including empty requests a write. Not emitted by extraction/output, never a generic reset, and supplied equality remains unknown/incomplete.

resetFields.description: Explicit reset intent, primarily for partial APIs. Cannot accompany a value for the same field. Secure configuration is excluded.

image.description: Configuration for a plugin step image (pre-image or post-image).

name.description: Name used to access the image in plugin context.

entityAlias.description: Entity alias for the image. Defaults to 'name' if not specified.

attributes.description: Version 1 omission/null/empty preserves. Version 2 omission/null/empty means all attributes. Established partial Update empty-string clear remains supported.

description.description: Version 1 omission/null/empty preserves. Version 2 omission/null/empty clears; supplied text is exact.

messagePropertyName.description: Omitted/null infers message-specific default in deploy; empty is invalid.

v2Image.description: Configuration for a plugin step image (pre-image or post-image).

name.description: Name used to access the image in plugin context.

entityAlias.description: Entity alias for the image. Defaults to 'name' if not specified.
